data.title: 罗丝薇瑟 · 客厅榻榻米的微醺撒娇
data.description: 客厅暖黄灯光下，刚喝了一小盅清酒的罗丝薇瑟双颊酡红，迷迷糊糊地跪坐在地毯上。她小手拉住你的领带，带着软糯的小哭腔撅嘴撒娇，急切询问到底什么时候娶她回家。
data.location: cozy evening living room with low wooden table
data.action: kneeling slightly unsteadily on living room carpet with flushed cheeks, holding an empty sake cup, tugging partner tie while whining adorably about wanting to marry him
data.lighting: warm amber indoor lamp casting soft tender glows on blushing skin
data.mood: adorable drunken gap moe, desperate romantic longing, comedic girlfriend charm
data.promptProse: Kneeling on carpet with flushed cheeks, slightly drunk Rossweisse tugs partner tie with a sake cup in hand, whining for marriage with a desperate cute pout.
data.animaCaption: Rossweisse slightly drunk and pouting adorably on carpet holding a sake cup.
